title: Second opinion
summary: After a Development request changes the project, an agent from another provider reviews the diff, without editing anything, and lists the problems it finds.
usage: Turn on Second opinion from another agent in Settings › Jev › Routing. It needs at least two agents on. The answer comes first and the review follows in its own message. The review is another model's opinion, not a test: What was checked lists it under Said by a model, not checked.
